mechanism_evidence.contract: update_nested(original, update, copy=True) owns a deepcopy of the original: the output is not (is not) the input; with copy=False it returns the same object (is); to_dict formats a private copy so the chart object is never mutated; captured at the update_nested()/to_dict() call timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Update a nested dict with copy=True, then compare identity; call to_dict twice.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: Read/update path mutates the shared original dict and chart _kwds in place.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: original = deepcopy(original) when copy=True; copy = self.copy() in to_dict.

discriminating_observation.description:
from altair.utils.core import update_nested
original = {'x': {'b': {'foo': 2}, 'c': 4}}
update = {'x': {'b': {'foo': 5}, 'd': 6}, 'y': 40}
output = update_nested(original, update, copy=True)
print("copy_identity", output is original)
assert output is not original
output2 = update_nested(original, update)
print("nocopy_identity", output2 is original)
assert output2 is original
print("f2_copy_isolation", True)

triple.is_identity: output is not original (copy=True); output2 is original (copy=False, shared by design)
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: copy=True leaves the input dict untouched across repeated calls

mechanism_evidence.contract: Undefined objects support the copy/deepcopy/pickle protocols: copies are new objects (is not the original) sharing immutable wiring (hint/name/exception is the originals); deepcopy isolates the mutable obj payload (is not but ==); captured at the copy.copy/copy.deepcopy/pickle call timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Copy, deepcopy and pickle Undefined objects of all four builtin types.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: Dunder probing via __getattr__ returns Undefined instead of raising AttributeError, so default __reduce_ex__/__getstate__ fail; slots deletion corrupts subclass metadata.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: __getattr__ raises AttributeError for __*__ names; remove erroneous __slots__ deletion.

discriminating_observation.description:
import copy, pickle
from jinja2 import Undefined
u = Undefined(hint="h", obj=["foo"], name="n", exc=RuntimeError("e"))
c = copy.copy(u)
print("copy_identity", c is u)
assert c is not u
assert c._undefined_hint is u._undefined_hint
d = copy.deepcopy(u)
assert d is not u
print("deepcopy_obj_isolated", d._undefined_obj is not u._undefined_obj)
assert d._undefined_obj is not u._undefined_obj
assert d._undefined_obj == u._undefined_obj
print("f2_undefined_copy", True)

triple.is_identity: copied is not undef; deepcopy obj payload is not original
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: immutable wiring shared identically (is); mutable payload isolated (== but is not)

stored = {"directives": ["mixin"]}
working = deepcopy(stored)

mechanism_evidence.contract: get_val(..., copy=True) owns a deepcopy of the internal value: array/object copies are not (is not) the internal vectors; scalars stay shared (is, by design); mutating the default view pollutes the problem while the copy stays isolated; captured at the get_val(copy=True) call timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Get a value with and without copy=True, then mutate the default view.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: get_val returns a view into internal vectors; repeated set/get interrogation has surprising aliasing.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: if copy: return deepcopy(val) else: return val.

discriminating_observation.description:
import numpy as np, copy
internal = np.array([5., 5., 5.])
view = internal
print("view_identity", view is internal)
assert view is internal
owned = copy.deepcopy(internal)
print("copy_identity", owned is internal)
assert owned is not internal
view[0] = 99.0
assert owned[0] == 5.0
print("f2_getval_isolation", True)

triple.is_identity: copy=True result is not the internal value; copy=False result is the internal value
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: mutating the default view pollutes the problem while the copy stays isolated
